_readme: Hand-curated by Bio. Every row needs a citation. Set verified_by_bio to true only after checking the paper's figures, not just the abstract. Rows marked TODO are drafts from abstracts.

orthologs._readme: fly_genes, relationship and diopt_score are what the code reads. diopt_score is the best fly gene's score: how many of the diopt_max DIOPT methods call the pair orthologous. diopt_rank follows DIOPT: high = best match in both directions (or score >= 5), moderate = best in one direction, low otherwise. Numbers come from the Alliance of Genome Resources orthology API (DIOPT-based, 9 methods apply to human-fly) on the retrieved date. Bio sets verified_by_bio after checking them in DIOPT. diseases puts a gene with no evidence row yet in that disease's gene picker, marked as having no cluster evidence.

PARK7._note: Both paralogs score equally. dj-1beta is broadly expressed and is the usual PD model; DJ-1alpha is mostly testis-enriched.

LRRK2._note: Weak call: only OrthoInspector and PhylomeDB match, and Lrrk's best human match is not LRRK2 (fly has one Lrrk for human LRRK1 and LRRK2). PANTHER alone also lists Phlpp (FBgn0032749) and CG10307 (FBgn0034655); both are low rank and left out of fly_genes.

SNCA._note: No-ortholog edge case: no method calls a Drosophila ortholog (Alliance lists only vertebrate orthologs). Fly PD models express human SNCA instead, so SNCA is a validation case, never a gene seed.

expression._readme: Bio (Kait). Bulk RNA-seq of genetically labelled cell types from data/expression_table.csv (head samples only), in TPM. An annotation on the mapping chain, never a seed filter: most PD genes are expressed broadly, bulk RNA-seq misses low transcripts, and this atlas profiled PAM only, so PPL1, PPL2, PPM1/2, PPM3 and PAL are 'not measured', not 'not expressed'. cell_types maps each atlas label to FlyWire types (crosswalk from Kait's table, PAM numbers per Li et al. 2020 and checked against MBON partners in FlyWire v783). inferred = one driver line per compartment; coarse = a line that pools several PAM types. fly_gene_names maps the table's spellings to fly_genes symbols.
expression.experiment: Davis et al., 2020 - cell types - head

targets._readme: Bio (Kait). Direct, one-synapse targets of the dopamine clusters, from data/downstream_by_flywire_type.csv: FlyWire v783 cell types that receive synapses from the PAL, PAM, PPL1, PPL2 and PPM1/2 neurons, the seed types themselves left out, at least 5 synapses per type. Connectivity only, no simulation. cluster_columns maps each evidence cluster to the table's syn_from_ columns; PPM3 has none, so it is reported as not covered. Target expression comes from data/combinedDatabase.csv (the head values of data/expression_table.csv) and is used only for the atlas labels in atlas_labels, on the FlyWire types listed there; excluded_labels are labels whose mapping in that file is wrong. fbbt ids come from data/clusterFBbt.csv. All of it is context: it never changes a seed, a confidence or a score. The pd_score, impact and perturbation columns are Kait's scoring proposal for CS1 and are not read here.
targets.citation: Kait's one-hop table, FlyWire v783 connections

alpha/beta core Kenyon cell ; alpha/beta._note: FlyWire KCab pools the core, middle and surface cells; the atlas profiled core and surface only.

mushroom body output neuron._note: The atlas pools two drivers, MBON-g1pedc>a/b (MBON11) and MBON-b'1 (MBON10). combinedDatabase.csv copies the label to all 35 MBON types; the other 33 are not measured.

adult NPF neuron._note: NPF promoter fusion, so it labels every NPF neuron, not one type.

Drosulfakinin neuron._note: Dsk promoter fusion, so it labels every Dsk neuron, not one type.

excluded_labels.centrigufal neuron: The atlas line is the C2 + C3 lamina centrifugal driver. combinedDatabase.csv maps it to nine FlyWire visual_centrifugal types (cL14, cL16, cL21, cL22b, LT39, LT41, LT56, cML01, OA-ASM1), which are other neurons. C2 and C3 get no dopamine input, so nothing replaces them.

cluster_to_cell_types._readme: Bio + CS1, built on day 1 by searching Codex. exact = the connectome names this cluster directly; inferred = matched by projection pattern.

PPL1._note: The FlyWire v783 annotations (flywire_annotations v3.2.0) also have PPL107 and PPL108 (2 neurons each, dopamine). Bio to decide whether they belong here.

PPL2._note: From the FlyWire v783 annotations (flywire_annotations v3.2.0): 8 neurons, 2 per type, all predicted and known dopamine.

PPM1/2._note: From the FlyWire v783 annotations: 16 neurons. The hemibrain names PPM1 and PPM2 together as PPM12. PPM1204,PS139 is one type name in FlyWire; its 4 neurons are predicted glutamate but annotated known dopamine.

PPM3._note: No FlyWire type is named PPM3. Picked central complex types whose known_nt lists dopamine from immunostaining or EASI-FISH, all but FB5H in the DM6 lineage. ExR2 likely corresponds to the PPM3 neurons that innervate the ellipsoid body (Hulse et al. 2021). FB6H and FB7B also stain for dopamine but are DL1-lineage glutamate neurons, so they are left out. 24 neurons; Bio to confirm each type.

PAL._note: From the FlyWire v783 annotations: 6 neurons, 2 per type, all dopamine.

ALL_DA._note: Every dopaminergic neuron, taking known_nt over the predicted top_nt: about 610 in FlyWire v783. top_nt alone calls about 5,170 Kenyon cells dopaminergic, but they are cholinergic, so never seed from top_nt alone.
